notes: ACCESS: Assigned URL node N-2758442726 is stale - it does not 404, it silently redirects to the homepage (confirms brief's warning re: bad slugs serving a plausible wrong page). Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) worked for robots.txt and the XML sitemaps (200, real content) but every live shop/category page (including the homepage itself) returned a generic Akamai/PerimeterX bot-management failover page ('Something went wrong') instead of real content - a soft block, not URL-specific. Tier (b) Playwright headless hit the identical failover page on the same URLs, confirming a bot-management wall rather than a dead link. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (the user's authenticated real Chrome session): first load showed a 'Powered and protected by [bot-management]' interstitial with a blank body (did not attempt to solve/click through any CAPTCHA); the session's own browser fingerprint/cookies cleared it silently on the next navigation and all subsequent category pages rendered normally with live item counts. All product-tree and quantity data below came from tier (c). robots.txt (fetched via tier a) has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow entries, so tier (c) use was permitted. TREE: union of categorySiteMap.xml (~1903 URLs, filtered to /shop/home* non-clearance/non-new-arrivals = 91 nodes) and the live 'Home' mega-menu flyout (columns: Pillows & Decor, Furniture & Lighting, Halloween, Bedding, Bath, Kitchen & Tabletop, More To Shop, Shop by Room, Shop by Style, Featured), cross-checked by screenshot/DOM read - the two sources matched. QTY: each leaf's own '<N> Items' DOM text on its rendered category page; h1/breadcrumb confirmed to match the requested node on every leaf recorded. EXCLUDED: Bath > Bath Accessories (111 items - sampled product tiles are predominantly marble trays/soap dishes/toothbrush holders/a bath light fixture, i.e. decorative bath accessories, not primarily textile or storage) and Bath > Soaps (not textile/storage); Outdoor (149 items, mixed furniture/planters/decor with only a few indoor-outdoor rugs/pillows inside and no dedicated Outdoor Rugs or Outdoor Cushions subcategory URL); Shop by Room hubs (Bathroom/Bedroom/Kitchen & Dining/Living Room - room aggregators that duplicate already-counted categories, room name alone is not a valid basis); Shop by Style (Global Home, Home Essentials, Neutral Living - curated style collections); Back To Campus, Fall Decor, Halloween, Holiday Decor (seasonal/promotional campaign sections); Gifts For Home (promotional); Luggage & Travel and Stationery (out of scope); Furniture & Lighting siblings (Chairs & Seating, Lighting, Tables - other workbooks' scope); Kitchen & Tabletop siblings (Cookbooks, Cookware & Bakeware, Cutlery & Flatware, Dinnerware & Serveware, Drinkware - Kitchen & Dining scope); Pillows & Decor siblings (Books, Candles, Decorative Accessories, Frames, Mirrors & Wall Art, Plants & Planters - Decorative/Wall Decor scope). DUPLICATES PREVENTED: 'Blankets & Throws' is reachable both under Bedding (N-2811442388) and under Pillows & Decor (N-4046227600) - both rendered identical h1 and identical '227 Items' count, so only the Bedding instance was kept. 'Baskets & Storage' is reachable both under the seasonal Back To Campus path (N-2565330239) and under Pillows & Decor (N-3350806704) - both rendered identical h1 and identical '75 Items' count, so only the Pillows & Decor instance was kept.
